features.text: POST-SURGICAL SUPPORT: Provides adjustable compression to stabilize abdominal muscles during recovery.
TRIMMABLE LENGTH: Custom-fit design adapts to your body for optimal comfort and secure closure.
CONTOURABLE HOOK-AND-LOOP SYSTEM: Ensures easy adjustment and uniform pressure distribution.
BREATHABLE ELASTIC MATERIAL: Allows airflow while maintaining firm abdominal support.
VERSATILE USE: Ideal for post-op, hernia, postpartum, or abdominal pain relief.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Support and compression of abdominal muscles
